text:
## Step 6: Risk Assessment  
### Risk Scoring  
**Customer Risk Level Determined By:**
- Age (18–65 = lower risk, >65 = higher)
- Nationality/residence (UK = lower, foreign = higher)
- PEP status (yes = higher)
- Adverse media (yes = higher)
- Product/account size (standard = lower, high-value = higher)  
**Risk Categories:**
- **Low Risk:** Standard customer, standard product, standard amount
- **Medium Risk:** Higher-value account or foreign residence
- **High Risk:** PEP, PEP family, adverse media, foreign high-value

raw_entities.name: Risk Assessment Process
raw_entities.description: A systematic process for determining customer risk level based on multiple factors including age, nationality, PEP status, adverse media presence, and product/account characteristics. The process categorizes customers into Low, Medium, or High Risk tiers to inform compliance and onboarding decisions.

raw_entities.name: Customer Risk Level Determination
raw_entities.description: The step in which customer risk is evaluated and scored based on five key factors: age, nationality/residence, PEP status, adverse media findings, and product/account size. This determination feeds into the risk categorization decision.

raw_entities.name: Risk Category Classification Gate
raw_entities.description: A branching decision point that assigns customers to one of three risk categories (Low, Medium, or High) based on the aggregated risk scoring factors. Each category triggers different compliance and operational pathways.
context: Low Risk: Standard customer, standard product, standard amount
Medium Risk: Higher-value account or foreign residence
High Risk: PEP, PEP family, adverse media, foreign high-value

raw_entities.name: PEP Status Screening Checkpoint
raw_entities.description: A mandatory compliance gate that verifies whether a customer or their family members hold Politically Exposed Person status. PEP status is a key risk factor that elevates the customer to Medium or High Risk category.
context: High Risk: PEP, PEP family, adverse media, foreign high-value

raw_entities.name: Adverse Media Screening Checkpoint
raw_entities.description: A mandatory compliance gate that checks for adverse media findings associated with the customer. Presence of adverse media elevates risk classification to Medium or High Risk.
context: High Risk: PEP, PEP family, adverse media, foreign high-value

raw_entities.name: Individual Customer
raw_entities.description: A natural person subject to risk assessment during the onboarding or account management process. Customer risk profile is determined by demographic, geographic, regulatory, and product-related factors.
context: Standard customer, standard product, standard amount

raw_entities.name: Standard Account
raw_entities.description: A standard-tier account product that carries lower risk classification when held by a standard customer with standard transaction amounts.
context: Low Risk: Standard customer, standard product, standard amount

raw_entities.name: High-Value Account
raw_entities.description: A higher-tier account product with elevated transaction amounts or balances that increases risk classification, particularly when combined with foreign residence or other risk factors.
context: Medium Risk: Higher-value account or foreign residence
High Risk: PEP, PEP family, adverse media, foreign high-value
